description: This is an HTML source file that defines the frontend interface for a Database Viewer web application, including CSS styles, structure, and embedded JavaScript for dynamic interactions and API communication.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and resets the view.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database to show/hide its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs the HTML table with given data and inserts it into the DOM.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Prepares individual cell content, handling nulls, objects, and long text with expand/collapse functionality.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Toggles full content display for a cell.
